highlights.title: A task can be closed as replaced
highlights.line: An agent can close a task as replaced by a later one: its page links to the new task, and the Tasks list says so.

highlights.title: Close a task and its subtasks at once
highlights.line: When a task's subtasks are all built or closed, one press on its page closes the built ones and then the task itself.

highlights.title: See which agent changed a file
highlights.line: A project's Documents screen, opened with View All under Files, usually shows which Claude agent changed a file last.

highlights.title: A paused room says why
highlights.line: When Kosmos pauses a room whose agents kept going back and forth, a note above the message box says why and offers Reopen.

highlights.title: A project shows each member's role
highlights.line: A project's member list now shows the role each member set for that project.
